tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Independent calculations. No portfolio changes are written.

catalog.emptyDescription: No healthy tools were returned by this catalogue. Reload after a tool is installed or repaired.
catalog.degradedToast: Tools loaded with unavailable entries or interfaces. See the catalogue for details.
catalog.diagnosticsHint: Read-only diagnostics are available in Settings → About → Plugin diagnostics.

availability.notInstalled: This tool is not listed in the current backend catalogue.
availability.backendUnavailable: This tool is unavailable on the backend. No calculation has been started.
availability.incompatible: This tool requires a compatible frontend build. No calculation has been started.
availability.rendererMissing: The backend tool is installed, but its interface is not included in this frontend build. No calculation has been started.
availability.rendererInvalid: The compiled interface registration is invalid or duplicated. No calculation has been started.

host.reloadWarning: Reloading replaces this tool interface and discards its current draft. Continue?

errors.network: The tool service could not be reached. Check your connection and retry explicitly.
errors.timeout: The tool request timed out. No result has been accepted and nothing was retried automatically.
errors.requestRejected: The server rejected the tool request.
errors.requestInvalid: The tool request failed local structural validation.
errors.protocol: The server response did not match the expected tool contract.
errors.mismatch: Tool metadata no longer matches this frontend. Reload explicitly to obtain updated metadata.
errors.internal: An unexpected tool interface error occurred.
errors.componentLoad: The tool interface could not be loaded.
errors.componentMount: The tool interface could not be opened.
errors.cleanup: The tool view was removed, but its cleanup reported an error.
errors.sessionChanged: The account changed. Previous tool data was cleared.
errors.stopped: Waiting stopped. This does not confirm cancellation on the server.

metrics.title: Backend timings
metrics.description: Measured by the backend, excluding network time. Phases can overlap; parallel items are not added to obtain the request duration.

about.readOnly: Read-only catalogue and diagnostics. No calculations, probes or repairs are run.
about.inactive: Open Plugin diagnostics to load tool metadata.
about.interfaceRegistered: Compatible interface registered in this build.

diagnostics.title: Tool diagnostics
diagnostics.scopeDescription: This snapshot describes one responding API process, not the whole instance. Catalogue and diagnostics are separate reads. Reload to update the snapshot.
diagnostics.degraded: Discovery failures or reduced execution capacity were reported. Other tools may remain available.
diagnostics.loaded: Tools loaded in this API process
diagnostics.noLoaded: No tools are loaded in this API process.
diagnostics.noFailures: No discovery failures were reported in this snapshot.
diagnostics.notLoaded: No diagnostic snapshot is loaded. Reload to request one.

policy.title: Effective platform limits
policy.description: Configuration limits, not measured timings or performance guarantees. Tool operations may declare stricter limits. Durations are not added together.
